description: Scaffold the complete frontend package: Vite+React+TypeScript setup, Tailwind CSS with dark mode, design system UI components, map components, and the application router. This is independent of FEAT-001 (the frontend does not import backend code) but relies on the API contract defined there. FEAT-003 (pages and hooks) depends on this feature.
steps: 1. Create packages/frontend/package.json with exact deps: react@18.2.0, react-dom@18.2.0, react-router-dom@6.22.1, leaflet@1.9.4, react-leaflet@4.2.1, lucide-react@0.344.0, clsx@2.1.0, tailwind-merge@2.2.1. Dev deps: typescript@5.3.3, vite@5.1.4, @vitejs/plugin-react@4.2.1, tailwindcss@3.4.1, postcss@8.4.35, autoprefixer@10.4.17, @types/react@18.2.61, @types/react-dom@18.2.19, @types/leaflet@1.9.8, vitest@1.3.1, @vitest/coverage-v8@1.3.1, @testing-library/react@14.2.1, @testing-library/user-event@14.5.2, @testing-library/jest-dom@6.4.2, jsdom@24.0.0. Scripts: dev (vite), build (tsc && vite build), test (vitest run), lint (eslint).
2. Create packages/frontend/tsconfig.json: target ES2020, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, jsx react-jsx, strict true, noEmit true (Vite handles emit). Include src. Exclude node_modules.

3. Create packages/frontend/vite.config.ts: defineConfig with plugins [react()], server proxy /api -> http://localhost:3001 (with changeOrigin: true — this lets the dev server forward API calls to the backend without CORS issues during development), test: {globals: true, environment: 'jsdom', setupFiles: './src/vitest.setup.ts', css: true}.

4. Create packages/frontend/tailwind.config.js: darkMode 'class', content ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], extend theme with fontFamily Inter, colors: primary indigo-600, add custom color tokens for status states. Require @tailwindcss/forms plugin if needed — decide no, keep minimal plugins.
5. Create packages/frontend/postcss.config.js: plugins tailwindcss and autoprefixer.

6. Create packages/frontend/index.html: standard Vite HTML shell with <link> to Google Fonts Inter (400,500,600,700), viewport meta, title 'Routeora — Plan your stops. Enjoy the journey.', <div id='root'>, <script type='module' src='/src/main.tsx'>.

7. Create packages/frontend/src/main.tsx: import React, ReactDOM, BrowserRouter, App (from ./App), the global CSS. ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<React.StrictMode><App/></React.StrictMode>).

8. Create packages/frontend/src/index.css: @tailwind base/components/utilities. Add body font-family Inter. Add leaflet CSS import (@import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'). Add CSS custom properties for light/dark theme tokens (--color-surface, --color-text, etc.) used sparingly alongside Tailwind.

9. Create packages/frontend/src/App.tsx: imports RouterProvider from react-router-dom, imports router from ./router. Wraps in ThemeProvider (a simple context provider that reads/writes localStorage and toggles 'dark' class on document.html). Returns <RouterProvider router={router}/>.

10. Create packages/frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript interfaces matching the Prisma models and API response shapes — Trip, Stop, RouteCache, RouteLeg, User, GeocodingResult, ApiResponse<T>, TravelMode enum, RouteMode enum, StopStatus enum (pending/current/visited/skipped).
11. Create packages/frontend/src/utils/cn.ts: exports cn(...inputs) using clsx + twMerge for conditional class merging. This is the single utility all components use for className construction.

12. Create packages/frontend/src/utils/api.ts: exports an api object with methods get<T>(path), post<T>(path, body), put<T>(path, body), patch<T>(path, body), del<T>(path). All prepend VITE_API_URL from import.meta.env. All send X-Session-Id header (read from localStorage key 'routeora-session-id', creating a nanoid if absent). All send Authorization Bearer token if present in localStorage key 'routeora-token'. Throws ApiError (custom class with message, status, details) on non-2xx. No hardcoded URLs.

13. Create packages/frontend/src/utils/navigationUrl.ts: same buildGoogleMapsUrl function as the backend util — duplicated intentionally on the frontend to avoid a network call just to get a URL string.

14. Create packages/frontend/src/router/index.tsx: createBrowserRouter with routes: / -> Landing, /trips -> Trips, /trips/new -> NewTrip, /trips/:tripId -> TripPlanner, /trips/:tripId/navigate -> TripNavigate, /share/:shareToken -> ShareView, /settings -> Settings. Wrap all routes except /share/:shareToken in a Layout component (top nav). Use React.lazy + Suspense for code-split pages with a LoadingSkeleton fallback.

15. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx: variants (primary indigo-600, secondary slate outline, ghost, danger red), sizes (sm, md, lg), loading state with spinner icon, disabled state. Uses cn() for classes. Accessible — passes through aria-* and type props.

16. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/Input.tsx: labeled text input with error state. Accepts label, error, helperText props. Uses <label> with htmlFor tied to input id. Focus ring in indigo.

17. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx: small status badge component. Variants: pending (slate), current (indigo), visited (green), skipped (amber), error (red). Rounded-full pill style.
18. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/Card.tsx: white/dark-surface card wrapper with optional padding, border, shadow. Accepts className for extension.

19. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx: modal dialog using a portal (ReactDOM.createPortal to document.body). Props: open, onClose, title, children. Includes overlay backdrop, close button (X), focus trap. Accessible: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby.
20. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/LoadingSkeleton.tsx: animated pulse skeleton. Variants: card, list-item, map-panel. Used while API data loads.
21. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/ErrorMessage.tsx: displays error string with red icon. Accepts message prop, optional retry onClick.

22. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/BottomSheet.tsx: mobile-only sliding panel from the bottom. Props: open, onClose, title, children, snapPoints (partial/full). Uses CSS transform transition. Includes drag handle. z-index above map.
23. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/ProgressBar.tsx: horizontal progress bar. Props: value (0-100), label, color variant. Used for trip completion tracking.

24. Create packages/frontend/src/components/ui/SearchCombobox.tsx: type-ahead search input for location search. Debounces input 300ms, calls onSearch callback, renders dropdown list of GeocodingResult items. Accessible with aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter, escape). Accepts isLoading prop to show spinner.

25. Create packages/frontend/src/components/map/MapContainer.tsx: wraps React Leaflet's MapContainer with default center Kolkata (22.57, 88.36), zoom 12, style height 100%. Fixes the common Leaflet default icon broken-image issue by importing and setting L.Icon.Default.prototype._getIconUrl workaround. Exports the map with ref forwarding for external zoom control.

26. Create packages/frontend/src/components/map/NumberedMarker.tsx: custom Leaflet DivIcon marker that renders the stop sequence number inside a colored circle (indigo for pending, green for visited, amber for skipped, red for current). Accepts stop number, status, selected (boolean — enlarges marker). Clicking triggers onSelect callback.

27. Create packages/frontend/src/components/map/RoutePolyline.tsx: renders the GeoJSON route geometry as a Leaflet Polyline. Props: geometry (GeoJSON LineString or MultiLineString), color (default indigo), weight (default 4), opacity (default 0.7). Renders nothing if geometry is null.

28. Create packages/frontend/src/components/trip/TripCard.tsx: card showing trip name, stop count, distance, last updated. Action buttons: Open, Duplicate, Rename (inline edit), Delete (with confirm). Used on /trips page.

29. Create packages/frontend/src/components/trip/StopCard.tsx: row showing sequence number badge, stop name, address, status badge, visit time if visited. Action icons: edit (pencil), delete (trash), drag handle (grip). Min height 44px for touch targets.

30. Create packages/frontend/src/components/trip/StopList.tsx: ordered list of StopCards with drag-and-drop reorder (using HTML5 draggable API — no external DnD library to keep deps lean). Fires onReorder only on dragEnd (drop), not on every drag step. Accepts stops array, selectedStopId, onSelect, onReorder, onEdit, onDelete callbacks.

31. Create packages/frontend/src/components/trip/RouteStats.tsx: compact panel showing total distance (km), total duration (formatted hh:mm), number of stops, travel mode icon. Shows recalculating spinner when stale. Shows 'Route not calculated' state with Calculate button.

32. Create packages/frontend/src/components/trip/ShareModal.tsx: dialog for sharing a trip. Shows share URL (read-only input with copy button), Regenerate Link button, toggle public/private. Uses clipboard API for copy. Shows QR code placeholder or just the URL.

33. Create packages/frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: top navigation bar with Routeora logo/wordmark (MapPin icon + text), nav links (My Trips, Explore), right side with theme toggle (Sun/Moon icon) and auth status (Login or user avatar). Renders <Outlet/> below.
34. Create packages/frontend/vitest.config.ts: re-export from vite.config.ts test config. Or defineConfig with test environment jsdom, globals true, setupFiles vitest.setup.ts.
35. Create packages/frontend/src/vitest.setup.ts: imports '@testing-library/jest-dom' to extend expect with DOM matchers. Mocks window.matchMedia for Tailwind dark mode tests.

36. Create packages/frontend/src/tests/components.test.tsx: unit tests for TripCard (renders name and stop count), ProgressBar (renders correct width percentage), Button (renders loading spinner when loading=true), Badge (renders correct variant classes).
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/frontend && npm run build exits 0 (tsc + vite build succeed)
cd packages/frontend && npm test runs vitest and all component tests pass
All UI components export named exports and accept the documented props without runtime errors
findings: All 36 steps implemented. Key decisions: (1) Added src/vite-env.d.ts with `/// <reference types="vite/client" />` and PNG module declarations to fix TypeScript errors for leaflet image imports and import.meta.env. (2) Leaflet default icon fixed by deleting _getIconUrl from prototype and calling L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions with imported image paths. (3) Leaflet CSS imported before @tailwind directives in index.css. (4) tailwind.config.js uses darkMode: 'class' for programmatic theme toggle. (5) nanoid v3.3.7 used in api.ts (CJS compatible). (6) All interactive elements have aria-label/htmlFor. (7) StopCard and BottomSheet have min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] touch targets. (8) Placeholder page components created; FEAT-003 will implement full page content. All verifications exit 0: npm install, npm run build (tsc + vite), npm test (17/17 tests pass).
